easyPrerequisites: You have at least as many cards in your library as the mana value of the permanent you intend to donate.
description:
Pay {3}{B} to cast Fateful Handoff, causing target opponent to gain control of (and you to draw cards equal to the mana value of) Old Fat Spider.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Old Fat Spider.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
